purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 611 Aguascalientes (city code 4184); city-bound registry evidence and safe anonymous parcel-geometry route.

registryBasis: The Aguascalientes municipal government exposes its Catastro/Predial system, and the official state Instituto Registral y Catastral identifies its online cadastral service. The official VisorAGS page shows a Predios layer and property-information flow. These establish local/state cadastral service presence, but no safe anonymous geometry-only endpoint/schema was verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Aguascalientes municipal government portal; links municipal services including Catastro/Predial.
Municipal Catastro/Predial login entry. Login flow was not used.
Official state Instituto Registral y Catastral cadastral-service page; requests property key and applicant documentation for a procedure. No form was submitted.

Official VisorAGS page lists a Predios layer and address/property-information controls. No address search, parcel selection or property-detail action was used; no geometry schema was exposed in the public page text.
